items.title: Pay outstanding balance for tree delivery/planting
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie die offene Summe bis zum 04.12.2026.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment ('bis zum 04.12.2026'), so no period calculation is needed. 2026-12-04 is a Friday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so the printed date stands as the due date.

warnings: This is a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) from a private company, not an authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery or appeal rules apply; the printed date of 04.12.2026 is simply the sender's own deadline.

The IBAN DE67 3705 0198 0005 5828 20 is a validly formatted German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove the account belongs to Gartencenter Beispielblüte; verify it against a previous invoice or the company's known bank details before paying, especially since the recipient's bank will separately check the payee name against the account (Empfängerüberprüfung).

The letter claims the person 'probably just overlooked' an earlier invoice for tree planting from October; if no such order or delivery (Lieferschein LS-26-7712) is recalled, check for a billing error or possible scam before paying.
